name: Read retrieval composition — Platform API source

parameters.content:
## Read-only context composition — Platform API binding
Byline: Codex · GPT-6.1-Sol · 2026-10-06.

Inputs: {flow:"read_retrieval", request_id, inputs:{query, leg_names:"intake,proffer", mode?:"keyword"|"hybrid"|"vector", scope_json?:JSON-string, limit?, per_leg_limit?, leg_timeout_seconds?}}.
Output: compact FlowResult from POST /v1/context/retrieve-flow, citations/ranks and explicit success/partial/failed, no excerpt bodies. Effects: configured context reads/query embeddings only. Pick for a Temporal-owned context read; never evidence promotion or indexing. Temporal owns durable retries.

Parent must register server.api.context_retrieval_routes.register_context_retrieval_routes on the existing Platform app and install its retrieval extra. Set n8n PLATFORM_API_URL to that existing service's reachable origin; no new server. HTTP header-auth credential must supply Authorization: Bearer using the existing platform-api-bearer credential, never an evidence capability. Bind the separate webhook header credential. Credentials remain unbound and active=false in source; this is not a live/runnable deployment claim. Environment access must be permitted by the installed n8n configuration or the deployment owner must bind the exact existing service origin in this node.

Server-only CONTEXT_RETRIEVAL_* allowlists select the upstreams, collections and explicit vectors. Intake uses /filesystem/search for all modes. Vector supplies a configured remote query embedding (requires upstream 634ced7f or later); Intake enforces active=true and text_vector, returns distance with score:null. The adapter uses negative finite distance, never a default score. Proffer uses configured matter prefilters and text_nim. Names shown describe current deployment; settings remain explicit. Installed n8n Weaviate node 1.3 has no named-vector target option; this wrapper never substitutes its default vector.

Caller matter/URLs/credentials are rejected. Source scope supports source_id, source_version_ids, thread_id, path_prefix; each leg fails unsupported scope before reads. Intake supports no source scopes; Proffer supports source_version_ids only and injects PROFFER_MATTER_ID itself. Source/version locators and exact object IDs survive; no invented URI. Graph reader remains unbound and evidence requires a future sanctioned capability adapter.
